title: Fouche saw the TR3B twice

tellings.quote: he Fuchche himself stated he had seen uh the craft twice. Once in Edwards Air Force Base and once somewhere else

plain: A man named Edgar Fouche said he had seen the TR3B, a secret triangular aircraft people talk about, twice in the 1990s: once at Edwards Air Force Base in California and once somewhere else. A commentator who goes by UAPGerb repeats this, citing a talk Fouche gave at the 1998 International UFO Congress. If true, it would mean such a craft was flying at a US military base.
